ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and proximal regions of both lobes are dominated by low-intensity black pixels. High-intensity white patches are localized at the distal tips and along the trailing edge of the right lobe. Smaller white focal points and mottling are visible on the distal half of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle; visible pixel depth constitutes approximately 15-20% of the fluke's vertical profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Consistent high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude of irregular tooth-like projections near the distal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex posterior sweep along the trailing edges, terminating in sharp, acute distal tips; leading edges are partially occluded by water surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-texture tan and white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity light-colored linear streaks (rake marks) are visible; three prominent diagonal parallel streaks on the left lobe and shorter, horizontal streaks near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface of the left lobe and significant biological encrustation on the distal tips.
